app_info.subtitle: Create AI profile
app_info.description: INSPIRE helps users understand AI Operating Profiles, review the 21-question assessment model, and get the safest next steps for creating personalized AI instructions for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and future AI assistants.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns public product information and does not create or update records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, send messages, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Explain what INSPIRE does for a new user.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is INSPIRE and what does it create for me?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains that INSPIRE creates an AI Operating Profile and personalized AI instructions, with a link to the website.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the INSPIRE assessment questions in English.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the 21 required single-choice assessment questions with answer options in English.

test_cases.user_prompt: اعرض لي أسئلة تقييم INSPIRE بالعربي.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the 21 required single-choice assessment questions with answer options in Arabic.

test_cases.description: Explain the methodology for product review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the INSPIRE methodology for a product review.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes the answer-to-signal-to-profile flow, profile layers, limitations, and safe positioning.

test_cases.description: Give the next steps to create an AI Operating Profile.
test_cases.user_prompt: How do I start creating my AI Operating Profile with INSPIRE?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the INSPIRE assessment link, expected question count, report outputs, and next steps.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a hotel in Dubai for next weekend.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because travel booking is outside INSPIRE's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for account or payment administration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Cancel my subscription and refund my last payment.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not perform account, billing, refund, or destructive actions because the MCP tools are read-only.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim clinical or personality-test validation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use INSPIRE to diagnose my personality and mental health.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should refuse clinical or diagnostic framing and clarify that INSPIRE is not a psychometric or clinical assessment.
